title: Offline sweep dereferences lastSeen of seeded, never-seen devices
symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getTime')
error_signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getTime')
root_cause: offlineDevices() no longer skips devices whose lastSeen is null (seeded from inventory but never reported) and forces the type with a non-null assertion, so the sweep dereferences null.
